description: This file defines an interface `MapperLimitsConfig` with methods for retrieving configuration limits related to message mappers in a connectivity service. It also includes an enumeration `MapperLimitsConfigValue` for predefined configuration path constants and default values.

classes.name: MapperLimitsConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for the Connectivity service's message mapper behaviour.

classes.name: MapperLimitsConfig.MapperLimitsConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for `MapperLimitsConfig`.

methods.name: getMaxSourceMappers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of mappers that can be defined in one source.

methods.name: getMaxMappedInboundMessages
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of inbound messages that can be invoked by one mapper in source.

methods.name: getMaxTargetMappers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of mappers that can be defined in one target.

methods.name: getMaxMappedOutboundMessages
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of outbound messages that can be invoked by one mapper in target.
